facts.business: Salona Cotspin Limited is engaged in the textile business, primarily manufacturing and selling yarn, fabrics, and garments.
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are at arm's length and in the ordinary course of business. Shareholder approval was obtained at the AGM on September 19, 2025 for material related party transactions. No material transactions under Section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 were entered into during FY26.
